documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Board Meeting To Be Held On July 27, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting Held On July 27, 2026

analysis.summary: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited reported a strong financial performance for FY26, crossing the INR10,000 crores revenue milestone with a consolidated revenue of INR10,739 crores, representing a 40% year-over-year growth. The fourth quarter consolidated revenue grew by 123% year-over-year to INR3,544 crores, driven by robust festive and wedding season demand, event-led sales, and retail network expansion to 78 stores. While Q4 gross margins faced dilution due to a higher mix of gold bars and coins, promotional discounts, and franchise additions, management guided for an FY27 revenue of INR13,500 crores along with an EBITDA margin of 7% to 7.5% and a PAT margin of 4%. P N Gadgil Jewellers reported robust Q3 FY26 performance with consolidated revenue growing 35.6% year-on-year to INR 3,302 crores and net profit surging 98.6% to INR 170.9 crores, driven by strong festive and wedding season demand despite elevated gold prices. The company expanded its store count to 66 with new openings in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, and onboarded new brand ambassadors.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue to close a little higher than INR 9,500 crores and be close to INR 10,000 crores for FY26.
guidance.quote: So hopefully we should cross the INR9,500 and be close to be INR10,000 Crores is what we are projecting.

guidance.claim: Management targets 20% to 21.05% growth over the year, aiming for around INR 12,000 crores in revenue for FY27.
guidance.quote: So around INR 12,000 crores is what we should be able to target for FY ‘27.

guidance.claim: Sustainable gross margins are projected at 13% to 14%.
guidance.quote: So we have always mentioned that around 13% to 14% gross margins is something which should be sustainable.

guidance.claim: Sustainable EBITDA margin is projected at 7% on an annualized basis.
guidance.quote: On an annualized basis, we had projected that we would see a increase in margins, EBITDA margins, and that should be sustainable at 7% to 7.25% is what we feel.

guidance.claim: Sustainable PAT margin is projected in the range of 3.75% to 4%.
guidance.quote: A PAT margin is around 3.75% to 4% is what we feel is sustainable in the long run.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching 78 to 80 stores by March 2026.
guidance.quote: In the current quarter, we plan to add approximately 11-12 new stores, comprising a mix of COCO company-owned and FOCO franchisee-owned stores across Maharashtra and Central India region, enabling us to reach our target of 78-80 stores by March 2026.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects jewellery demand to see further uptake while the sale of bars and coins will go down drastically.
demand_outlook.quote: I'm expecting that the sale of coins and bars will go down drastically. Prices have gone up, and we see a lot of exchange gold coming in, which would be beneficial because it will come up with making charges.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that jewellery demand is kind of inelastic, whereas investment demand is elastic.
demand_outlook.quote: And this is what we are seeing that jewellery demand is kind of inelastic, but investment demand is elastic and when the duty has gone up, we will see a dip in people's interest in gold as an investment in bars and coins.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that inventory turnover outside Maharashtra is crossing 1x in the first year itself.
demand_outlook.quote: So, like our guidance we had projected around 0.8x stock turn for the year one, so we have we have surpassed the guidance and all the stores in primary UP, Bihar, and MP are doing annualised stock turns of 1x in the first year itself.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer sentiment remained resilient despite elevated gold price levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite the elevated price levels, the consumer sentiment remained resilient.

demand_outlook.claim: Traditional gold jewellery remained a core focus while lightweight jewellery continued its upward shift.
demand_outlook.quote: Traditional gold jewellery remained a core focus, while lightweight jewellery continued with upward shift amid price volatility and shifting consumer preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: Festive demand was a key growth driver, leading to record-breaking sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Festive demand was a key growth driver in this quarter, with record-breaking sales of INR 190 crore-plus on Dussehra and INR 606 crores on Diwali, leading to the highest ever monthly sale of INR 1,800 crores in October month.

demand_outlook.claim: Footfalls in UP and Bihar stores exceeded expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: By that I mean that the footfalls were encouraging and were exceeding what we had expected.

demand_outlook.claim: Investment demand for gold bars and solid forms has gained traction.
demand_outlook.quote: So see, there's a definitely there's a shift in investment demand which is which is further gaining traction.

capex_expansion.claim: During Q4 FY26, the company added 12 new stores, taking the total store count to 78 as of March 31, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: During Q4 FY26, we added 12 new stores, 8 COCO, in which 3 legacy and 5 LiteStyle, and 4 FOCO, 1 legacy and 3 LiteStyles, taking our total store count to 78 as of March 31st, 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: On a full year basis, the company added 25 new stores in FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: On a full year basis, we added 25 new stores, reinforcing our position as one of the fastest-growing organized jewellery brands in the country.

capex_expansion.claim: Planned new store locations for the year include Gurgaon, Lucknow, and entering Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: The locations which we are venturing into is in Gurgaon, strengthening our position in Lucknow, and we have also venturing into Gujarat.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched three exclusive company-owned stores during the quarter, entering Patna, Bihar and reaching 66 stores.
capex_expansion.quote: We launched three exclusive company-owned stores during the quarter, marking our entry into Patna, Bihar and taking our store count to 66 at the end of the quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: Short-term plans for Uttar Pradesh include opening 8 to 10 stores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, I think UP as a state can accommodate around 8 to 10 stores, is the short-term plan for the brand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add approximately 25 more stores in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: So, FY March ‘26 we should be nearing around 80 stores and I think FY ‘27 we would be adding, depending on the QIP we do it, but at a comfortable pace we can look at around adding 25 more stores.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for PNG stores is approximately INR 2 crores for store fit-outs.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for our PNG stores is around INR2 Crores in terms of the store fit-outs and around INR70 lakhs for the Litestyle stores.

margins_costs.claim: There was a gross margin dilution of almost 2.3% in Q4 FY26 compared to Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: So as of when we compare Q4 of FY26 versus Q4 FY25, the there was a gross margin dilution of almost 2.3%, 230 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: Marketing promotion and trade discounts were in excess of INR50 crores during Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Also, to mention as we have mentioned ahead, with the promotional activities targeting Gudi Padwa and with the with the Foundation Day and the Gratitude Day offer, the marketing promotion and trade discounts were in excess of INR50 crores, which again had a impact on the margins.

margins_costs.claim: Franchise gross margins are typically in the range of 2.5% to 3%.
margins_costs.quote: and the franchise gross margins are in the range of 2.5 to 3%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q3 FY26 grew by 35.6% year-on-year to INR 3,302 crores.
margins_costs.quote: For the quarter, Consolidated Revenue from Operations grew by 35.6% year-on-year to INR 3,302 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit rose by 98.2% year-on-year to INR 474 crores in Q3 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Gross-Profit rose by 98.2% year-on-year to INR 474 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Net profit surged 98.6% year-on-year to INR 170.9 crores, with a net profit margin of 5.2%.
margins_costs.quote: While net profit surged 98.6% year-on-year to INR 170.9 crores, with the net profit margin standing at 5.2%.

margins_costs.claim: The company stopped the sale of the zero-margin refinery business, which impacted margins positively.
margins_costs.quote: Primarily the first reason was that we had stopped the sale of the zero margin refinery business. Now that was definitely the key factor which would have an impact on margins.

margins_costs.claim: Advertising expenses increased due to store expansion and brand ambassador appointments.
margins_costs.quote: See, the other expenses, primarily the increase has been in the advertising expenses, because the number of stores have increased from 47 to 65. Expansion in newer states from Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar. Signing up of Ranbir Kapoor and Sara Tendulkar as brand ambassadors has been the primary driver.

orders_capacity.claim: Same-store sales growth for Q4 FY26 stood at 86% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our same-store sales growth for Q4 FY26 stood at a robust 86% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The inventory turnover ratio for FY26 stood at 3.8x.
orders_capacity.quote: and an inventory turnover ratio of 3.8x, together underscoring sustained operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Transaction volumes were up by 35%, with an average transaction value of INR 1,03,065.
orders_capacity.quote: Our transaction volumes were up by 35%, with an Average Transaction Value i.e. ATV of INR 1,03,065.

orders_capacity.claim: Footfall grew by 33% with a conversion rate of 94%.
orders_capacity.quote: Footfall grew by 33%, supported by a strong conversion rate of 94%, demonstrating sustained consumer interest despite volatile gold prices.

orders_capacity.claim: Same-store sales growth for Q3 was 33%, and average revenue per store for nine months ended December 2025 stood at INR 109 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: At the store level, the same store growth continued strong for the quarter, was at 33%, and for nine months, December ended 2025, average revenue per store stood at INR 109 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Revenue per square foot stood at INR 3,42,800, with a net profit of INR 4.8 crores per store.
orders_capacity.quote: Revenue per square feet was INR 3,42,800, with a net profit of INR 4.8 crores per store.

orders_capacity.claim: Inventory turnover remained healthy at 3.2 times.
orders_capacity.quote: The inventory turnover remained healthy at 3.2 times, underscoring sustained operational efficiency and profitability.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's long-term credit rating was upgraded to A+ stable from A during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also pleased to share that during the quarter, our long-term credit rating was upgraded to A+ stable from A, while the short-term rating was reaffirmed at A1.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that gold bar and coin sales operated on a structurally very thin spread, and the elevated contribution compressed consolidated gross margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: As this segment operates on a structurally very thin spread, the company's overall core retail jewellery business, the elevated contribution compressed the consolidated gross margins due to consumer shift of gold from consumption to gold for investment in Q4 FY26.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets to reach an 80% hedging proportion by FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So next year we should be at 75% to 80%.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to reach 78 to 80 stores by March 2026.
management_commitments.quote: In the current quarter, we plan to add approximately 11-12 new stores, comprising a mix of COCO company-owned and FOCO franchisee-owned stores across Maharashtra and Central India region, enabling us to reach our target of 78-80 stores by March 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to add approximately 25 more stores in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So, FY March ‘26 we should be nearing around 80 stores and I think FY ‘27 we would be adding, depending on the QIP we do it, but at a comfortable pace we can look at around adding 25 more stores.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching 105 stores at the end of March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: 105 stores at the end of March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The QIP resolution is effective until August 2026.
management_commitments.quote: See, QIP plans, like we are saying, that we have taken the approval from the Board, which is good till end of August 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
